summary: Coeur d'Alene NF L-4 cab near Lakeview, built 1940 and gone by 1961; a November 2024 visit report found no remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Gone by 1961. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives both Destroyed and Removed for 1961; Forest Lookouts lists it as Removed. A November 9, 2024 visit report found no remains.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source says whether the site is open to the public

events.note: L-4 cab, per firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts
Idaho Fire Lookouts: '1961: Destroyed | Removed'; firelookout.com: 'Gone 1961'; Forest Lookouts: 'Removed' with no year

evidence.supports: about five miles south-southwest of Lakeview
1961 recorded as both Destroyed and Removed
writers went up and took photographs
evidence.quote: we have photos to prove we went up there

evidence.supports: no tie-downs, piers, wires or trash found
evidence.quote: no tie downs, no concrete piers, no wires, no cans and trash

evidence.supports: writers described the spot as though the lookout never existed
evidence.quote: Its as if the lookout was never here.

corrections.why: Typo in the brief; firelookout.com spells the forest Coeur d'Alene

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts gives Destroyed | Removed for 1961, firelookout.com gives only 'Gone 1961', and Forest Lookouts gives Removed with no year. The brief said destroyed; the event is recorded as removed and the story says it is unclear how it ended.

notes_for_editor: Brief said destroyed for 1961; sources say destroyed or removed, so the event is recorded as removed with the conflict noted. Brief agency typo corrected. Bonner County and 4,580 ft elevation come from firelookout.com. No staffing is documented by any source, so none is recorded. One WebSearch found no independent source. Only the November 9, 2024 Idaho Fire Lookouts post describes the site today. No photo URLs found.
